messages:
nina: Heads up — production paging started dropping for a subset of services ~10m ago. Incidentbot created alerts but the paging connector never ACKed a bunch of them. I see 'opaque_ack_id drift' in the connector logs. @omar can you take a look? :eyes:

omar: On it. I'm seeing a backlog in notify-proxy and lots of retries. Pulling logs now.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-4321. Automated action: disabled auto-escalation to external pager integrations until triage complete.

katie: If this won't be quick, we should switch to manual paging for the affected customers and phone loop. @michael can you run the manual page script?

michael: Running manual page script now. Quick log snippet from connector:
```
2026-02-24T14:12:03Z connector-3 warn ack-mismatch id=0x7f5c server_ack=0x1a2b expected_ack=0x3c4d route=acme
2026-02-24T14:12:04Z connector-3 error pd-502 upstream=503 message="ACK token not found"
2026-02-24T14:12:04Z connector-3 info leader-change old=inst-9 new=inst-12
```

omar: Hypothesis: leader election happened and the connector restarted but kept using stale/opaque ack tokens from its local cache. Pager (PD) rejects those because routing table changed -> pages drop. I can reproduce in staging by forcing leader swap.

katie: Mitigation: rotated the connector instances (terminated pods) and cleared the local ack cache on the active node. Manual pages are going through now but there are still delayed escalations.

nina: Customer impact: tenant "AcmeCorp" missed the initial page for ~12 minutes. CS notified and account exec informed. No wider user-facing outage but this is a P1 for paging reliability.

ops: Temporary measure: add fail-closed check — if ack token doesn't validate, reject and fallback immediately to SMS relay so we don't silently drop. Also enable alert when ack_mismatch_rate > 0.5% over 5m.

oncall-automation-bot: Manual pages sent to oncall-alpha via phone loop (+1-555-0101).

michael: Patch ready: include leader UUID in ack cache key and make cache TTL conservative. Plan rolling deploy tomorrow 07:00 UTC. Will also add metric ack_mismatch_rate and a small canary that swaps leader on staging every deploy to catch this.

omar: Post-incident actions: add leader-swap unit test, add integration test that validates ack tokens across leader changes, and add runbook step to clear ack cache after leader election until we have sticky tokens.

sre-bot: Status update: Mitigated at 1715127200 — pages resumed after rotation and cache clear. Monitoring window set to 60m. Marking status: "Mitigated" (not fully resolved).

katie: Assigning postmortem owners: nina (incident lead), michael (fix + deploy), omar (test coverage), katie (customer comms). I'll draft a short customer note for AcmeCorp.

nina: Quick notes for retro: - Add canary leader-swap test in CI - Tighten ack cache TTL and bind ack tokens to leader id - Ensure on-call phone fallback is exercised in runbooks

michael: Also adding a CI job to simulate connector restarts and validate paging end-to-end.

katie: Thanks all. I'll keep CS + AE updated and we can close once the 60m window passes and ack_mismatch_rate is 0 for two consecutive 5m windows. :white_check_mark:
